own_solution.law: Parallel resistors share the source voltage: P = V²(1/R1 + 1/R2). Here 1/R1 + 1/R2 = 0.25 Ω⁻¹, giving P = 36 W. An aiding series cell gives P(q) = 0.25(12 + q)² W for q expressed in volts: 45.5625 W, 56.25 W and 64 W at 1.5 V, 3 V and 4 V respectively. The first branch normally carries 2 A, below every listed fuse rating.
assumptions: Negligible source, wire and intact-fuse resistances are treated as zero.
The separately powered fan has no electrical coupling to the resistor circuit.
The fuse operates normally and is intact below its rating.

T6182.regime: The intact fuse has negligible resistance and V/R1 < q; the branch current is 2 A and all listed thresholds exceed it.

T164F.regime: Normal intact-fuse operation with V/R1 < q; the branch current is 2 A and all listed ratings exceed it.
